item.title: Centralized Monitoring: Log Analytics, Diagnostic Settings, and Azure Monitor Workbooks
item.description:
The incident ticket lands on a Tuesday morning. Production degraded last Friday. You open the Azure portal, pull up the subscription’s Log Analytics Workspace, and realize the diagnostics on the App Gateway were never enabled. The VNet flow logs are going to a different workspace some application team created six months ago. The Key Vault audit logs aren’t going anywhere at all.

You have logs. You just can’t see any of them from the same place at the same time.

item.title: Day-2 Operations: Maintaining and Evolving Your Azure Landing Zone
item.description:
Nine months after go-live, internal audit asks a simple question: do the firewall rules running in production today match the ones that were approved? You run terraform plan to prove it. Fourteen changes come back. Three are rule edits someone made in the portal during an incident. One opened a port to a vendor IP range. None of them has a pull request.

Deploying your landing zone was the easy part. Now you have to live with it.
